name: Crema Catalana
assumptions: Yield of 6 inferred from 6 ramekins in instructions.
Preparation time of 60 minutes is a conservative estimate covering active steps (infusing 30 min, whisking ~15-20 min, cooling 1 hr noted but not fully counted as prep).
Egg Yolks are from chicken eggs.
Corn Flour is pure corn starch (no wheat).
Caster Sugar is pure sucrose with no additives.
No wheat, barley, rye, or uncertified oats present.
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, soy, or sesame listed.
instructions:
step 1
Put the milk, cream, cinnamon stick and all the citrus zest in a saucepan set over a medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until the milk is just steaming but not boiling, about 3-5 mins. Remove from the heat, cover with a plate and leave to infuse for at least 30 mins.

step 2
When the cream mixture has infused, whisk the egg yolks, sugar and cornflour together in a separate bowl for 3-5 mins, or until light and pale in colour. Pour the infused milk through a sieve into the egg mixture, whisking continuously. Return the mixture to the saucepan.

step 3
Put the saucepan over a medium-high heat and whisk for around 10-12 mins. The mixture should start thickening to a custard-like consistency – you can tell it’s ready by dipping a wooden spoon in the mixture, then running a finger through the mixture on the back of the spoon. If the line holds, it's ready. Sieve the mixture into a jug to remove any froth.

step 4
Divide the custard between six 150ml ramekins or small terracotta dishes, then leave to cool for 1 hr at room temperature until set with a slight wobble. Chill overnight.

step 5
Just before serving, sprinkle 1 tbsp caster sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelise using a kitchen blowtorch. Alternatively, slide the ramekins under a hot grill until the sugar turns golden and starts to bubble. Serve straightaway.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Whole cow's milk; 400 ml converted using density ~1.02 g/ml; standard nutritional profile for full-fat milk.

ingredients.name: Double Cream
ingredients.assumptions: Double (heavy) cream; 150 ml converted using density ~1.02 g/ml; typical UK double cream values.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon Stick
ingredients.assumptions: One standard cinnamon stick (~3 g); contributes negligible macros after infusion and sieving; values approximated from dried cinnamon.

ingredients.name: Orange Zest
ingredients.assumptions: Zest from one medium orange (~6 g edible zest); standard orange peel nutritional values.

ingredients.name: Lemon Zest
ingredients.assumptions: Zest from one medium lemon (~4 g edible zest); standard lemon peel nutritional values.

ingredients.name: Egg Yolks
ingredients.assumptions: 7 large egg yolks; average 17 g per yolk; standard raw egg yolk profile.

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: White caster sugar; used in the custard base; pure sucrose values.

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 6 tablespoons caster sugar for caramelising tops (~12.5 g per tbsp); pure sucrose values.

ingredients.name: Corn Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Cornflour (corn starch); standard dry cornflour nutritional profile.
